rules.provenance: Mixamo animations downloaded by the Animama project owner under the owner's Adobe account and converted to VRMA. Shipped only inside the desktop app and the hosted service as non-portable Included content for avatar playback: never in source, self-host images or public packages, never exportable or copyable, and never used to create, train, test or improve machine-learning systems. Per-clip provenance is kept privately by the owner. Decision: https://github.com/raymond-van/animama/issues/242 and docs/adr/0018-non-portable-included-content.md.
